name: rocketbrain

projectName.description: JDT project name for classpath resolution.

classPaths.description: Explicit application classpath, or omit to resolve from the project.

javaExec.description: Standalone Java executable used to run the application.

hotCodeReplace.description: Apply changed method bodies only when explicitly requested.

rocketbrain.sql.analysis.resolutionScope.description: Match a workspace-relative SQL file or a folder path ending with / to a local DDL catalog. The most specific path takes priority.

rocketbrain.java.inspectionProfiles.description: Named Java inspection profiles with source globs, per-rule severity and duplicate detection settings.

rocketbrain.sql.templates.description: SQL templates with prefix, body and optional description. Context fields include relation, table, schema, columns and key.

rocketbrain.http.environments.description: Named sets of HTTP text variables. Store credentials with Set HTTP Environment Secret.

rocketbrain.java.enabled.description: Start Rocketbrain's directly connected Java language engine in trusted workspaces.

rocketbrain.java.serverPath.description: Absolute path to an independently downloaded Eclipse JDT Language Server distribution.

rocketbrain.java.javaHome.description: Absolute path to a standalone JDK 25 or later for the language server. Do not use an IDE's embedded runtime.

rocketbrain.java.fileTemplates.description: Additional Java file templates. The template body accepts ${name}, ${package}, and ${packageDeclaration}.

rocketbrain.java.liveTemplates.description: Additional Java snippets with a prefix, body and optional description.

rocketbrain.java.postfixCompletion.description: Suggest Rocketbrain postfix transformations for reviewed Java expression shapes.

rocketbrain.java.gradleHome.description: Optional absolute path to an independently installed Gradle distribution for project import.

rocketbrain.java.gradleJavaHome.description: Optional standalone JDK path for importing Gradle projects.

rocketbrain.java.debugBundlePath.description: Absolute path to the separately provisioned open-source Java debug JDT plugin JAR.

rocketbrain.java.hotCodeReplace.description: Allow explicitly triggered Java Hot Code Replace; no automatic source edits or code replacement.

rocketbrain.java.projectJdks.description: Project execution environments, e.g. name JavaSE-21 with a standalone JDK path.

rocketbrain.spring.enabled.description: Enable Rocketbrain's Spring source analysis and configuration assistance.

rocketbrain.spring.activeProfiles.description: Profiles selected for static Spring analysis.

rocketbrain.spring.properties.description: Explicit property overrides for static Spring analysis.

rocketbrain.spring.basePackages.description: Optional source package boundaries for the analysis model.

rocketbrain.spring.configurationRoots.description: Explicit Spring configuration directories, relative to a workspace folder or absolute. Multiple unscoped application contexts remain uncertain.

rocketbrain.spring.closedWorld.description: Treat the selected source model as the complete bean set. Enable only for controlled projects; external auto-configuration may otherwise supply missing beans.

rocketbrain.spring.parameterNames.description: Use Java parameter names as bean-name fallback when the application is compiled with -parameters.

rocketbrain.spring.diagnostics.enabled.description: Publish diagnostics for supported Spring resolution cases; unresolved dynamic conditions remain unknown.

rocketbrain.spring.runtime.url.description: Local Actuator base URL. No request is made until Connect Local Runtime is explicitly invoked.

rocketbrain.spring.runtime.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for explicitly requested runtime observations.

rocketbrain.spring.runtime.maxResponseBy.description: Maximum bytes accepted per runtime response.

rocketbrain.jpa.enabled.description: Analyze supported JPA source mappings and JPQL references.

rocketbrain.jpa.basePackages.description: Explicit source package boundary for this JPA model; ambiguous persistence-unit bindings remain unresolved.

rocketbrain.jpa.mappingFiles.description: Optional ORM XML file paths inside workspace folders, relative or absolute. When empty, discover META-INF/orm.xml. Explicit paths replace automatic discovery; each file must be local and no larger than one MiB.

rocketbrain.jpa.diagnostics.enabled.description: Publish JPA diagnostics for supported mapping and query cases.

rocketbrain.jpa.physicalNaming.description: Explicit physical naming assumption for mapping/catalog comparison. Unknown naming does not prove a missing physical table.

physical.description: Fully qualified physical naming strategy class available in workspace source, or a supported Hibernate built-in.

implicit.description: Fully qualified implicit naming strategy class available in workspace source, or a supported Hibernate built-in.

rocketbrain.jpa.namingStrategy.description: Explicit naming configuration. A bounded source interpreter reads supported pure methods without loading Java classes. Unsupported behavior and missing profile entries remain unresolved; no automatic catalog guessing is performed.

rocketbrain.java.testing.runtimePath.description: Path to the separately provisioned java-testing-runtime.json. Empty uses the extension storage installation.

rocketbrain.java.testing.projects.description: Explicit compiled Java test project profiles. Empty resolves imported Maven/Gradle test classpaths through the independent Java language engine.

framework.description: JUnit Platform or TestNG runner; automatic resolution creates separate profiles when both are imported.

rocketbrain.sql.analysis.enabled.description: Analyze supported SQL scopes using the explicitly connected database catalog, without executing the analyzed SQL.

rocketbrain.sql.project.roots.description: Local query folders inside the workspace for bounded semantic .sql reference scans. Empty scans workspace SQL files. Unsupported migrations or SQL are reported as incomplete and block a combined source rename.

rocketbrain.java.mavenHome.description: Optional Apache Maven home for explicit Java project tasks. Maven is not bundled.

rocketbrain.spring.initializr.endpoint.description: HTTPS Spring Initializr service used for explicit metadata and project creation requests.
